title: Platinum Rewards Card: Using Virtual Cards for Online Shopping and Subscriptions
summary: Explains how to use Platinum Rewards Card virtual cards for online checkouts, recurring subscriptions, and one-time purchases. Virtual cards are included with membership, with up to 30 active at once, no extra virtual-card fee beyond the $200.00 standard annual fee, and guidance to delete/recreate cards if a merchant is compromised.
faqs: When should I use virtual cards with my Platinum Rewards Card?
